description: Main program file for a .NET web backend, setting up services, middleware, health checks, API endpoints, and environment configuration for a data asset management system.

classes.name: ValidityCheckRequest
classes.description: DTO for the request payload to validate a string value.

classes.name: ValidityCheckResponse
classes.description: DTO for the response payload indicating validity status of a string value.

methods.name: LoadDotEnvIfPresent
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file if it exists, supporting export syntax and quotes.

methods.name: BuildPublishedServerUrl
methods.description: Constructs the server URL for publishing OpenAPI docs, considering explicit environment variable, origin header, and forwarded headers.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenApiDocument
methods.description: Sets up the OpenAPI/Swagger document to use the correct server URL based on incoming request.
